capabilities: plot 2D and 3D graphs from Wolfram Mathematica code
extras: Not registered as a standard community plugin; users must clone it into .obsidian/plugins/, run npm run build, and enable it manually. The README says it is in the revision process and lists unfinished features (exporting an image file with a wikilink, plotting several graphs in a row).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to render mathematical plots from Mathematica code.
summary: Math plotter that renders 2D and 3D graphs from Wolfram Mathematica code with live preview and editing.
